name: Kiriya Botan
source:
[i]The Whimsical Second Daughter[/i]

She is the most flashy of the six Kiritani sisters, known for her hedonism and ephemeral beauty.

A promiscuous woman who is sexually open-minded.

Currently, she is studying abroad and has left the Kiritani family.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/kiriya/main.html]Official Site[/url]]
